prediction.method: Share of past seasons' weather (2009–2023) in which this option leaves the most per acre over operating costs, among corn and soybeans in three rotations. Same price and cost every year: only the weather changes.

confidence.reason: From 5 of the last 5 USDA crop maps. In most years the corn share here and in similar counties moved within about 8 points.

mix.method: This county's usual crop changes over its last 5 USDA crop maps, assuming its corn and soybean area stays about the same. The range is how far this county and its 5 most similar counties moved away from their own habit in past years (most years fall inside). It does not use prices or the yield model yet.
